description: "The Pulpit of the Reformation, Nos. 1, 2, 3, and 4" by Welch, Knox, and Latimer is a collection of religious sermons written in the early 19th century. This work compiles significant discourses focusing on themes of judgment, morality, and faith, delivered by notable reformers from earlier centuries.
